name: update_rolling_release_config
description:
Update or disable Rolling Releases for a project via requestBody (for example enabled, advancementType, and stages with targetPercentage). When disabling, disableRolloutAction resolves an active rollout: "abort" rolls back (default) or "complete" promotes the canary to production. Config changes affect only the next production deployment. Enabling also turns on skew protection with its default if not configured.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/projects/{idOrName}/rolling-release/config --method PATCH. Fill placeholders from inputs.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.
